Google Search Console

Understand how Google Search discovers and presents your pages.

GSOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Google Search Console provides website search performance and indexing information. MoreSpace can structure query and page analysis, investigate discoverability issues, and connect organic search trends with the customer journey so SEO work is guided by observed website outcomes and documented data limits.

Useful outputs

  • Query and page performance views with clear filters
  • Reviewed indexing investigations and prioritized website actions
  • A repeatable organic report with documented row and quota limits

Where we can apply it

  • Search queries → page grouping → relevance review → content improvement brief.
  • Priority URL → inspection findings → developer task → recheck discoverability.
  • Search clicks → landing journey analysis → qualified enquiries → organic scorecard.
01

Use case 1

Review clicks, impressions, click-through rate, and position by page and query.

02

Use case 2

Investigate important pages using coverage and URL inspection information.

03

Use case 3

Build a governed organic performance report through scoped API access.

Inputs we need

  • Verified property access and important page inventory
  • Target markets, branded query rules, and reporting periods
  • Source data definitions and approved extraction schedule

Delivery sequence

  • Agree property scope, date ranges, and the business questions to investigate.
  • Extract and reconcile performance data, then inspect priority page issues.
  • Connect reviewed actions with source-backed search and enquiry outcome reporting.

Expert review points

  • Check aggregation and missing-query limitations before interpreting totals.
  • Validate technical recommendations before changing live website indexing behavior.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • GA4
  • Semrush
  • Ahrefs
  • Reporting tools

Signals we can make visible

  • Organic clicks
  • Search impressions
  • Search CTR
  • Average position
